selection: Two images per class/background/magnification stratum: median image ID plus lowest-sharpness alternative
overlay_key: Red indicates pixels the mask would remove
findings: Corrected dark-tail polarity retains much of the visible material on many black-background examples.
On white backgrounds, both methods remove substantial visible material, including pure semolina examples img_0541, img_0547, img_0560 and img_0561.
Colour thresholding favours warmer particles and removes pale regions; lightness thresholding follows shadows and grain texture instead of a complete material boundary.
Dense low-sharpness black-background images such as img_0254 and img_0355 still expose background-polarity/threshold failures.
feature_policy: Use unmasked valid RGB regions for whole/crop/detail descriptors; no zero-filled artificial mask edges
quantitative_scope: Coverage fractions are pixel counts, not segmentation accuracy or adulteration by volume
